OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_SCOPE.description: The scope of the connector, i.e. the type of STIX objects it imports.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_DURATION_PERIOD.description: The period of time to await between two runs of the connector.

TSC_API_BASE_URL.description: Base URL of the Tenable Security Center API instance.

TSC_API_ACCESS_KEY.description: Access key used to authenticate against the Tenable Security Center API.

TSC_API_SECRET_KEY.description: Secret key used to authenticate against the Tenable Security Center API.

TSC_API_TIMEOUT.description: Timeout, in seconds, of the Tenable Security Center API requests.

TSC_API_BACKOFF.description: Backoff duration, in seconds, between two Tenable Security Center API retries.

TSC_API_RETRIES.description: Number of retries of the Tenable Security Center API requests.

TSC_EXPORT_SINCE.description: Datetime (ISO-8601) used as the starting point of the very first data retrieval. It is overwritten by the connector state after the first successful run.

TSC_SEVERITY_MIN_LEVEL.description: Minimum severity level of the findings to import.

TSC_PROCESS_SYSTEMS_WITHOUT_VULNERABILIT.description: Whether to import the systems that have no vulnerability attached.

TSC_MARKING_DEFINITION.description: TLP marking definition applied to all the imported entities.

TSC_NUMBER_THREADS.description: Number of threads used to retrieve data from Tenable Security Center.
